unit.title: Kangaroo Round
unit.about: The follow-on round: 25 problems with no options to choose from – every answer is a whole number from 0 to 999.
unit.note: Written by the Atomic teaching team in the style of national maths challenges. Not UKMT papers.

01.prompt: A photo measures 20 cm by 13 cm. It has a border 2 cm wide all the way round. What is the area of the border?
How many square numbers are greater than 247 and less than 553?
What is the next number in this sequence? 14, 26, 38, 50, 62, …
At a party, each of the 21 guests shakes hands exactly once with every other guest. How many handshakes are there?
The red dashed line is a line of symmetry. What is the smallest number of extra squares that must be shaded so that the shape is symmetrical about the line?
How many prime numbers are there between 53 and 77?
Matchsticks are used to make squares in a row. How many matchsticks are needed to make 51 of them?
The pages of a book are numbered from 1 to 295. How many digits are printed altogether?
How many of the whole numbers from 1 to 150 are multiples of 4 or 10 (or both)?
A 5 × 5 × 5 cube is painted on the outside and then cut into 125 small cubes. How many small cubes have exactly three painted faces?
All the whole numbers from 1 to 150 are written down. How many times is the digit 3 written?
Quinn and Jamal share some sweets in the ratio 5 : 9. Jamal gets 32 more sweets than Quinn. How many sweets are there altogether?
The diagram shows three angles around a point. What is the value of x?
What is the value of 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + … + 53?
What is the sum of the digits of 10¹³ − 7?
What is the remainder when 11²³³ is divided by 9?
A snail is at the bottom of a well 17 m deep. Each day it climbs up 5 m, but each night it slides back 2 m. On which day does it first reach the top?
In a triangle, one angle is 60°. Another angle is 4 times the third angle. What is the size of the largest angle?
3 apples weigh the same as 2 pears. A pear weighs 34 g more than an apple. How much does one pear weigh?
The number 2220 is written in base 3. What is it in base 10?
Each interior angle of a regular polygon is 162°. How many sides does the polygon have?
How many pairs of positive whole numbers (x, y) satisfy 2x + 5y = 84?
How many different arrangements are there of the letters of the word COFFEE?
The number 43! means 43 × 42 × … × 2 × 1. How many zeros are at the end of 43! ?
An ant walks along the lines of a grid from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner of a 4 × 3 grid of squares, moving only right or up. How many different routes are there?

02.prompt: Kim is 8 years older than Vik. In 6 years' time the sum of their ages will be 38. How old is Vik now?
The sum of 3 consecutive whole numbers is 228. What is the largest of the numbers?
What is the value of 100 − 99 + 98 − 97 + … + 2 − 1?
A square has perimeter 24 cm. It is cut into two identical rectangles. What is the perimeter of one rectangle?
Two whole numbers add up to 33. What is the largest possible value of their product?
A three-digit number has digits a, b, c (in that order), where a − c = 2. The digits are reversed and the new number is subtracted from the original. What is the result?
How many factors does 128 have? (Include 1 and 128.)
How many integers n (positive or negative) satisfy 5 < n² < 180?
Two numbers have sum 39 and difference 17. What is their product?
Vik's mother is 3 times as old as Vik. In 11 years she will be 2 times as old as Vik. How old is Vik now?
A rectangle has sides of length 6 cm and 8 cm. How long is its diagonal?
The clock shows 3:40. What is the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand?
What is the last digit of 8¹⁵⁸¹?
The mean of 4 numbers is 39. When one more number is added, the mean becomes 42. What number was added?
A triangle has vertices at (4, −2), (−1, 3) and (−1, −3). What is its area?
A cuboid has faces with areas 28 cm², 56 cm² and 32 cm². What is its volume?
How many three-digit numbers have digits that add up to 5?
If x + 1/x = 4, what is the value of x² + 1/x² ?
How many squares of any size can be found on a 7 × 7 chessboard-style grid of unit squares?
A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards, like 474. How many three-digit palindromes are multiples of 4?
The number 101110 is written in base 2. What is it in base 10?
What is the remainder when 3¹⁰⁵⁴ is divided by 11?
Two whole numbers have highest common factor 2 and lowest common multiple 40. Neither number is equal to 2. What is their sum?
A rectangle is divided into a 2 × 5 grid of unit squares. How many rectangles (of any size, including squares) can be seen?
The product of three consecutive whole numbers is 29 760. What is their sum?

03.prompt: The red dashed line is a line of symmetry. What is the smallest number of extra squares that must be shaded so that the shape is symmetrical about the line?
The sum of 3 consecutive whole numbers is 126. What is the largest of the numbers?
Two whole numbers add up to 37. What is the largest possible value of their product?
Yusuf and Grace share some sweets in the ratio 4 : 7. Grace gets 9 more sweets than Yusuf. How many sweets are there altogether?
At a party, each of the 19 guests shakes hands exactly once with every other guest. How many handshakes are there?
What is the last digit of 3³⁴³?
A snail is at the bottom of a well 30 m deep. Each day it climbs up 6 m, but each night it slides back 2 m. On which day does it first reach the top?
Elif's mother is 4 times as old as Elif. In 6 years she will be 3 times as old as Elif. How old is Elif now?
Matchsticks are used to make squares in a row. How many matchsticks are needed to make 54 of them?
How many square numbers are greater than 56 and less than 269?
The diagram shows three angles around a point. What is the value of x?
The mean of 7 numbers is 30. When one more number is added, the mean becomes 28. What number was added?
The pages of a book are numbered from 1 to 254. How many digits are printed altogether?
A three-digit number has digits a, b, c (in that order), where a − c = 2. The digits are reversed and the new number is subtracted from the original. What is the result?
How many three-digit numbers have digits that add up to 18?
All the whole numbers from 1 to 150 are written down. How many times is the digit 2 written?
The number 106! means 106 × 105 × … × 2 × 1. How many zeros are at the end of 106! ?
How many factors does 48 have? (Include 1 and 48.)
What is the sum of the digits of 10¹⁴ − 7?
A triangle has vertices at (−2, 6), (−1, 1) and (5, 5). What is its area?
A rectangle has sides of length 9 cm and 12 cm. How long is its diagonal?
How many integers n (positive or negative) satisfy 55 < n² < 301?
The digits of every whole number from 1 to 99 are added together. What is the total?
For how many whole numbers n from 10 to 200 does n² end in the digit 6?
What is the smallest whole number greater than 10 that leaves remainder 2 when divided by 9, remainder 6 when divided by 7 and remainder 6 when divided by 8?

04.prompt: What is the next number in this sequence? 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, …
How many prime numbers are there between 50 and 69?
What is the value of 50 − 49 + 48 − 47 + … + 2 − 1?
A photo measures 10 cm by 13 cm. It has a border 2 cm wide all the way round. What is the area of the border?
Leo is 2 years older than Kim. In 5 years' time the sum of their ages will be 30. How old is Kim now?
The clock shows 11:50. What is the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand?
3 apples weigh the same as 2 pears. A pear weighs 46 g more than an apple. How much does one pear weigh?
How many of the whole numbers from 1 to 120 are multiples of 3 or 5 (or both)?
In a triangle, one angle is 95°. Another angle is 4 times the third angle. What is the size of the largest angle?
Each interior angle of a regular polygon is 120°. How many sides does the polygon have?
What is the value of 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + … + 31?
A 6 × 6 × 6 cube is painted on the outside and then cut into 216 small cubes. How many small cubes have exactly three painted faces?
Two numbers have sum 13 and difference 1. What is their product?
All the whole numbers from 1 to 250 are written down. How many times is the digit 7 written?
How many squares of any size can be found on a 7 × 7 chessboard-style grid of unit squares?
A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards, like 474. How many three-digit palindromes are multiples of 3?
How many different arrangements are there of the letters of the word LLAMA?
A cuboid has faces with areas 21 cm², 12 cm² and 28 cm². What is its volume?
An ant walks along the lines of a grid from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner of a 5 × 5 grid of squares, moving only right or up. How many different routes are there?
If x + 1/x = 5, what is the value of x² + 1/x² ?
How many pairs of positive whole numbers (x, y) satisfy 4x + 7y = 82?
A rectangle has sides of length 20 cm and 21 cm. How long is its diagonal?
Five different positive whole numbers have mean 11 and median 10. What is the largest possible value of the biggest number?
A club has 7 boys and 6 girls. A team of 2 boys and 2 girls is chosen. How many different teams are possible?
What is the value of 1² + 2² + 3² + … + 13² ?
